Data in **hh:e:Sato:Pygmees**, **hh:hv:Klieman:Gabon**, **hh:hvw:Klieman:WEquatorial**
of the language spoken by the Mikaya, Bambengangale and Baluma in the Republic of Congo are so different from other languages in the Likouala-Sangha Bantu subgroup that a separate entry is required. These lects are not covered in any form in any other entry in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29.
